pr_body:
Closes #7529

Partial resolution to #6966 (icons for mania key mods; seems like font weight is not right).
pr_comments: I'm starting to wonder if `ModIcon` wouldn't fare better as a `ModelBackedDrawable`. Your current implementation looks quite close already, although not overly obviously (it's not a straightforward change, but more of a major refactor).
Definitely could do with a refactor to MBD but it's not super necessary for now though, imo.

issue_context.title: Display `Acronym` instead of question mark when mod does not have icon
issue_context.body:
Seems easy to implement, and might look better.

**Proposal designs of the feature:** See title. Use `OsuFont.Numeric` to display.
comments: sounds good. we could switch a lot of existing ones to use this (where they are using incorrect icons currently).
